nph.text: The Mirran Resistance is made of the Mirrodin survivors who oppose Phyrexia, which broke down Mirrans and rebuilt them as loyal servants of the force they had fought.
After Phyrexia conquers Mirrodin, Urabrask lets Mirran survivors take refuge in the Furnace Layer and seals it from other factions, and when the resistance arrives he decrees "Let them be."
Elesh Norn lays waste to Urabrask's domain and the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters, where Koth leads them to form new nomadic groups, and the Resistance heals Karn through Venser's sacrifice.
